acceptance_predicates.description: One structured helper is the only permitted source of public human status/progress rendering, with compile-time or mechanical enforcement against ad-hoc status writes.
A completed step under one second has no transient progress rendering; a step exceeding one second begins and updates a progress bar until terminal completion.
Known totals render real completed/total and rough remaining time from caller-fed observations; unknown totals render indeterminate activity and elapsed time without fabricated completion or ETA.
TTY rendering redraws safely with clipping and cleanup, while redirected output is append-only plain text with no ANSI or control bytes.
Quiet and JSON modes instantiate no visible reporter and emit no status, update, or progress bytes on either stream.

definition_of_done: Deterministic clock, PTY, redirected-stream, and writer-failure tests cover the reporter lifecycle.
Contributor documentation requires structured work-unit updates for all eligible steps.
Independent review, exact-head checks, signed merge, and exact-main evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1771 fixed-width states, quiet behavior, JSON silence, stream, and color rules.

outputs.description: Shared structured Rust API and renderer for human operation status and progress.
Deterministic clock, terminal, and redirected-output test harness.

gates.description: Clock-driven tests prove threshold, update, finalization, interruption, and no-leaked-render behavior.
PTY, redirected, quiet, and JSON tests prove the exact rendering/silence boundaries.
Tests reject fabricated totals or ETAs and exercise truthful known/unknown-work updates.
